name: Hypothermic
description: You are freezing cold and cannot recover Health until you warm up. Each Shift of continued exposure forces a Stamina roll to avoid further damage.
notes: Clear after warming up by a campfire or other heat source.

name: Starving
description: You have gone too long without food. You cannot recover Health until you eat a full ration.

name: Sick
description: You are afflicted by disease or infection and cannot recover Health until you fight it off.
notes: Clear by succeeding an infection roll.

name: On Fire
description: You are burning and take 6 points of damage at the start of each round until the flames are extinguished.

name: Poisoned (Lethal)
description: Lethal poison courses through you, dealing 1 point of damage each round.

name: Poisoned (Paralyzing)
description: Paralyzing poison stiffens your muscles, giving -3 to all Strength and Agility rolls.

name: Poisoned (Sleeping)
description: Sleeping poison dulls both body and mind, giving -3 to all attribute rolls.

name: Entangled
description: You are caught fast and cannot move, with -1 to Strength and Agility rolls until you break free.
notes: Clear by winning a Melee Combat roll (slow action).

name: Prone
description: You are knocked to the ground, with -1 to Strength and Agility rolls until you get up.
notes: Clear by spending a fast action to stand up.

name: Tremble
description: You are trembling uncontrollably, giving -2 to all Strength and Agility rolls.
notes: Clear when all stress is relieved. (Panic result 8.)

name: Frozen
description: Fear roots you in place for a round, giving -3 to all Strength and Agility rolls.
notes: Clears automatically after one round. (Panic result 10.)

name: Sleep Deprived
description: You are exhausted from lack of sleep, with -1 to Wits and Empathy rolls, and cannot recover Resolve.
notes: Clear by sleeping one full shift.
